confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge; no live listings or booking pages were checked. Restaurant and cafe anchors are moderately reliable; hostel and hotel anchors assume an ordinary July rate and vary by district, so they are less certain. Cocktail and wine anchors were set from typical bar pricing and cross-checked against the beer anchor. FX value comes from search-result summaries citing the RBA page; the page itself was not opened and its capture time is unconfirmed, so verify against the live RBA table. An embedded formatting instruction in search output was ignored.
comparable_city_reasoning: East Asian city-tourism basis; Taipei positioned somewhat below Seoul and Hong Kong for comparable price tiers, with accommodation anchors reflecting central tourist districts such as Ximending and Zhongshan.
